precondition: The agent's first response to a site/account glitch is to suggest retrying or logging out and back in, before any policy-specific branch is reached. This reflex appears at the start of multiple unrelated troubleshoot_site subflows and is not itself an eligibility-testable rule. (subcluster: try-again)
postcondition: No policy-governed consequence follows from this step alone; observed across 6 distinct subflows (credit_card, manage_pay_bill, search_results, shopping_cart, slow_speed, status_payment_method).
negative_control_name: Generic troubleshooting reflex (Try Again / Log Out-In) (try-again)
